task: Design monitoring and health dashboard for the pointer network

1_health_metrics_design.description: Six core metrics for continuous pointer network health monitoring

metrics.name: Network Connectivity Score
metrics.computation: Based on connected components (undirected), graph diameter (BFS from sampled nodes), and bridge edge count (Tarjan's algorithm)

current_value.score: 1.0 minus penalties for multi-component, large diameter, or high bridge fraction

metrics.rationale: A disconnected or high-diameter network means agents cannot efficiently traverse. Bridge edges are single points of failure. S5 confirmed diameter=4, radius=3, single component of 310 nodes.

metrics.name: Orphan Rate
metrics.computation: Count nodes with zero incoming pointers divided by total node count
metrics.rationale: Orphan nodes are unreachable via pointer traversal. High orphan rate means the network has dead-end regions. Currently 29.7% which is above the 25% critical threshold.

metrics.name: Strength Coverage
metrics.computation: Fraction of edges with strength classification (primary/supporting/related/tangential) vs unclassified
metrics.rationale: S1 showed primary-path journeys have 100% success, while random walks with unclassified edges have much lower success. S6 confirmed weight-based routing (80% success) outperforms tag-based (45%). Strength labels are critical for routing quality.

metrics.name: Route Success Rate
metrics.computation: Success count / total routes from route_log.jsonl, plus recent-20 trend detection
metrics.rationale: Direct measure of whether agents can find what they need. S1 showed 56% overall success across journey types, but controlled routes in production achieve higher rates. Below 70% triggers warning.

metrics.name: Path Efficiency
metrics.computation: Average hops to reach resource nodes (SCR/SRC) from SOP nodes, combining static BFS analysis and dynamic route log data
metrics.rationale: S1 showed primary paths average 1 hop while exploration averages 3 hops. S7 found 61.7% of SOP-SRC pairs reachable within 3 hops. Longer paths waste agent time and increase failure probability.

metrics.name: Tag Coherence Score
metrics.computation: Average Jaccard similarity of tag sets between source and target nodes across all edges, broken down by strength level
metrics.rationale: S6 showed tag-based routing has only 45% success vs 80% for weight-based. S8 found avg_tag_coherence of 0.0 across workflows. Low coherence means edges are not semantically justified by shared tags. This is the weakest metric currently.

2_health_check_script.description: Complete health check script that runs all 6 metrics and produces pass/fail report
features: Runs all 6 metrics against live pointer-network.json and route_log.jsonl
Produces structured JSON report with per-metric status (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP)
Computes overall health score (0-100%) as weighted average of metric scores
Generates alert objects with severity levels (CRITICAL/WARNING/INFO)
Multiple output modes: text report, JSON, single-line dashboard, watch mode
render_network_health_section() function for direct dashboard.py integration
Configurable thresholds dictionary for all alerting rules
Bridge detection using Tarjan's algorithm for connectivity analysis
Trend detection on recent route success rates

3_alerting_rules.description: Rules for when the system should warn about network degradation

rules.rationale: A disconnected network means some nodes are entirely unreachable. S5 confirmed current network is fully connected.
Current diameter is 4 (S5). Higher diameter means longer worst-case traversals.

rules.condition: Bridge edge fraction > 5% of total edges
rules.rationale: S7 found SCR-0007 is a critical SPOF. Bridge edges create fragility.
Currently at 29.7% (CRITICAL). Nodes with no incoming pointers cannot be discovered.
Currently at 18.4% (CRITICAL). S1 showed unclassified edges correlate with navigation failures.

rules.condition: Route success rate drops below threshold
rules.rationale: S1 showed 56% overall success across all journey types. Production routes currently at 98.8%.

rules.condition: Recent 20-route success rate drops >5pp below overall average
rules.rationale: Catches degradation before it becomes systemic.

rules.severity: WARNING at >4 hops, CRITICAL at >6 hops
rules.rationale: S1 showed primary paths average ~1 hop; exploration averages 3. Beyond 4 hops indicates structural issues.

rules.condition: Any SOP node cannot reach any resource (SCR/SRC) via BFS
rules.rationale: S7 found 100% reachability at unlimited hops but only 61.7% within 3 hops.

rules.condition: Average Jaccard tag similarity across edges drops below threshold
rules.rationale: Currently at 0.007 (CRITICAL). S6 showed tag routing only 45% effective. Tags need repair.

rules.condition: >50% of edges have zero tag overlap
rules.rationale: Currently 98.6% have zero overlap. Edges without shared tags provide no semantic signal.

rules.condition: >20% of edges added since last check are unclassified
rules.rationale: Prevents strength coverage from degrading as network grows.

4_dashboard_integration.description: How to integrate network health into the existing dashboard.py
4_dashboard_integration.approach: The network_health.py module exports render_network_health_section() which returns a list of formatted strings matching dashboard.py's section pattern

integration_steps.description: Add a --network flag to dashboard.py's argument parser
In render_dashboard(), add the section after findings
Add network health data to the --json output mode

4_dashboard_integration.watch_mode_support: Both dashboard.py --watch and network_health.py --watch support continuous monitoring. The dashboard integration calls render_network_health_section() each refresh cycle.

5_current_network_diagnosis.summary: The pointer network has strong structural connectivity (single component, diameter 4) and excellent route success (98.8%), but suffers from three critical weaknesses

critical_issues.issue: Tag coherence is near zero (0.007 avg Jaccard)
critical_issues.impact: Tag-based routing only achieves 45% success (S6). Edges lack semantic justification.
critical_issues.recommendation: Run a tag propagation/enrichment pass to ensure connected nodes share relevant tags

critical_issues.impact: 81.6% of edges have no strength label, making route recommendations unreliable for most paths
critical_issues.recommendation: Batch-classify edges using weight thresholds and reason patterns (shared_tags count, explicit_reference presence)

critical_issues.issue: Orphan rate is 29.7% (92/310 nodes with no incoming pointers)
critical_issues.impact: Nearly a third of nodes are unreachable via reverse traversal
critical_issues.recommendation: Add backlinks for high-value orphan nodes, particularly wiki-* and SRC-* nodes

strengths: Diameter of 4 with radius 3 (efficient traversal possible)
98.8% route success rate in production use
Average path efficiency of ~2.5 hops to reach resources
Cross-domain traversal succeeds in 1 hop from all SOPs (S3)

6_stress_test_insights_used.S1: Journey type success rates: primary-path 100%, exploration ~45%, random-walk ~23%. Validates that strength classification directly drives success.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S2: Script fan-out analysis: avg 3-hop reach of 204/310 nodes. Hub scripts (SCR-0003, SCR-0020) reach 213. Dead-end scripts (SCR-0018) reach only 161.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S3: All SOPs hit cycles when following lowest-weight pointers (adversarial). 4.26M unique cycles found. All cross-domain hops = 1. Validates network is cycle-rich but still navigable.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S4: Recommendation system handles 40 concurrent-style calls across 8 task types. 30 seeded routes with 57% success rate.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S5: Deep graph: diameter=4, 1 component of 310, center has 124 nodes. Structural foundation is sound.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S6: Weight routing (80%) beats hybrid (75%) beats tag (45%). Tag coherence ~0.37-0.45 in controlled tests. Weight is the primary reliable routing signal.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S7: SOP-to-SRC 3-hop reachability at 61.7%. SCR-0007 is critical SPOF (removing it breaks 32 paths). Gateway dependency is a structural risk.
6_stress_test_insights_used.S8: E2E workflow: 8/15 success, 7/15 partial, 0 failures. Avg tag coherence 0.0 in real workflows. Weight/strength labels needed.
